_doc: AI-06 recommended overrides on top of ai05_params.json 'flight' and ai09_params.json 'landing', per lift model (rounded from reports/best_gains.json; verified with gain_sweep --given at 200 landings + 200 dives + all-class steps, numbers in reports/verify.csv). 'damping_only' is also a safe default under speed_scaled (cross-check in the PR); 'speed_scaled' fails every landing under damping_only. Not applied anywhere: AI-19 decides what goes into autopilots.json. A-68 prefers one gain set for both models, so 'damping_only' is the candidate for that.
